title: Home with the Lord Forever
speaker: Jonathan Baird
summary: There is a sigh of relief when you cross the threshold of home. One day we will know that relief in the house of the Lord forever.
exhortation: One day we will be with the Lord in his house. I once stayed at the home of a pastor friend and went to church with his family. Afterward I went back to the house while he, being the pastor, stayed until the last people left. I was sitting in the living room when he got home, and he didn't see me right away. I'll never forget hearing him let out an involuntary sigh of relief as he crossed the threshold. I don't think he even realized he did it. It was just his reaction to being home.

That may sound random, but it was profound to me. There is something about home. After a long day of work, it's as if your body is aching to be home and can't really relax until you get there. There's a release of tension when you walk through the door. I love my home: my wife, my kids, my couch, my chair, my snacks, my coffee maker. Have you ever come back from a long trip, maybe not a great one, and been so excited to be home? I've heard stories of soldiers who wanted to kneel and kiss the ground when they got back to America.

As Christians, that is what we will feel when we come to our real home. The house of the Lord will be a refuge, a comfort and a rest. Because of the mercy poured out over us through Jesus, we will have that sigh of relief. The tension will fall off our backs like a weighted vest. We will sink into a rest far more delicious than any five-star resort, because it will be home: brand new, yet more familiar than any home on earth. There will be family and food and fellowship, like the comforts we knew as children at Christmas and the joy of a great evening with friends, and we will be perfectly protected by our Father and perfectly at ease.

As we think about the wonderful future ahead of us, let it make us marvel at the mercy and goodness of our God: that he would come to rescue us and love us enough to make us part of his family, so that we can be home with him forever. And let it put a passion in our hearts to share this good news of love and mercy with those around us.
prayer: Lord, help us not to grow too comfortable with everything we have on this earth. This is not our home. We aren't here to put down permanent stakes. We are living for another country, another home, a place you are preparing for us.

Help us live today in light of eternity, and truly believe in our hearts that a single minute in your presence, at home with you, is better than being anywhere else. We put our trust completely in you, Lord. Our hope is in you.
